reviews.classification: mixed historical scope / source and output correction / later integration evidence
reviews.disposition:
Full mixed audit/campaign/reader checkpoint under AD32/AD36/AD42/AD43/AD49/AD51. The early two-auditor dispatch,58 focused passes, incomplete making-adapter processes and three differently scoped UI samples remain that audit's evidence. No completed adapter suite or finished fight/lead reload follows from stopped workers or six inspected captures. Later implementation tracker/campaign and KJ3AE/AD/AC/AB/AA/Z supersede KJ3H/D endpoints for their recorded windows;101 selected early stages and431 selected later stages are not exhaustive source denominators. Old title dates, next paragraphs, worker/model/usage/stop instructions and preview metadata establish no present workers, authority to dispatch/commit or current endpoint beyond the latest owning receipt.

PF13 remains a proposed workflow comparison. Four pilot shards yield74 structured rows(44D/27F/3R), normalized IDs and selected locator checks, not playable implementation, complete source fidelity or proven cost advantage. Full-size card metadata is retained input, not a written/usable pack. Arc-ahead reading creates new edition-specific locators despite earlier other-edition/full-read claims; it does not authenticate equivalence. WA shape, parser/reference and sampled locator checks are separate from reading every row's actual source. Oversized rows, copied runs and unclear/derived fields remain coverage limits after format repairs.

Keep reading plans/results chronologically: the initial one-reserve plan/five-invocation result is followed by seven total invocations/four windows plus three repairs, one per repaired window. Do not backdate later repair usage into the original bounded result or silently certify every stated allowance decision. The a1/a4 sampled claims and15-row a1b/a2/a3b sample have different scopes; a4b's earlier unclear start is retained. Reader token estimates are measured/estimated task costs, not budget ownership or current usage. Stage/percentage/model/deadline sentences are dated execution plans, not controls for this reconciliation.

The later ch44 correction supersedes the alleged100-versus200-pound contradiction:100 is the halved-if-police counterfactual,200 full commission and10 the selected share. Candidate money extraction is not an AD49 anchor until paragraphs are checked;66 candidate paragraphs differ from28 checked figures. Two conversion slips and one unsupported attribution were corrected by the original coordinator, not freshly source-verified here. Probe3's rough268000 remainder is superseded by probe4's measured164754 and probe5's74314 for their actual ranges. Probe5's all-volume1-read means the stated mechanism lens through ch213, not every source sentence/action/actor qualified or full first-novel gameplay. G14–G17 and amendments are backlog proposals; no runtime followed that reading result. All original paragraphs/tables/endings were read, recovering48–62/61–end after truncation; no linked private reader/source body, code, worker or test artifact was inspected.

reviews.disposition:
Historical14-act withdrawal/range continuation under AD36/AD42/AD43. Preserve all eight intent mappings/B1–B7/source/recipient rows. Actual cathedral/range/office IDs are reused and two genuinely unmatched spaces authored, not every unfamiliar translation turned into a new place. Firearm practice/brass-spent/silver-reloaded remain factual staging without an actual firearm skill/stock consumer at this receipt's time.

Three fare debits2760−6−6−4=2744 are model arithmetic on an assumed starting purse inherited from KJ3K's unstated coppers. Paid change/source coin handover and banknotes-as-items remain separately unmodeled; range badge access is not an invented numerical fee. Fourteen acts across chapter edges are action inventory, not a source percentage. Clock720-minute Friday-night fill is authored and no literal hour is asserted. Actors/recipients only learn observed or spoken content; watcher inference and Dunn's private plan stay separate.

Pinned KJ3E bundle/two-attempt seeded KJ3K continuation and literal import retain their identities. Initial confession failure is not a passing attempt; prescan/preflight/leak regex have format/static/selected-output scope. No14/21 captures, civil clock, earlier-chain replay or current build evidence was added. The phrase below the human gate is historical: human review is optional AD42, distinct from actual missing proof. KJ3M subsequently owns the Benson/night continuation with its own known short-dawn workaround, not an extension of this run. Full receipt read does not inspect private chapter/pack, current source, actual save or browser.

reviews.classification: mixed historical scope / source and output correction / later integration evidence
reviews.disposition:
Historical seven-intent examination with two later corrections, under AD36/AD42/AD43. Preserve source/continuity windows,155 narrative paragraphs versus translation footnote and authored61-minute duration; sunset/night inconsistency remains unresolved rather than silently resetting the native clock. Source-specific lucidity/provider aromas are not general spirit sight, mind extraction or universal defense. The existing examiner body/display-name correction avoids a second identity. The provider's synchronization allocation appears after actual entry, not an invented eager grant.

Later entry requires the actual examiner instead of relocating her into presence; missing/departing support blocks or stops without reconstructing a meeting. More importantly the confidentiality request in ch14 is not assent: the final source-order correction moves the real commitment and recipient promise to ch15 during invitation discussion. Later contact/open-offer consumers depend on that actual assent, not a generic trust gate. A pending invitation, attributed examination result and salary estimates are not signed employment, guaranteed safety or paid wages. Same-site abstract movement and folded conversation preserve actual actor/resource/recipient support; they do not implement a broad social/legal engine.

The full seven-intent route, three-check changed-entry proof and four-action/seven-check corrected continuation have different pack identities/dependency scopes. No single final-pack fresh campaign or complete-route rerun is implied. Unchanged provider/pending/support/Stop evidence is explicitly reused; final chronology/persistence/font proof addresses changed rows. Immediate partially painted headless image is rejected for visual proof in favor of settled14/21 frames. Twenty-two unchanged focused tests and a build do not close the old pre-commit timeout or certify a full suite. Prototype pending jobs need their matching prototype pack; no migration of unpublished candidates was claimed. Old preview/server and source hashes are historical. Later KJ3E/F supplies household/contract boundaries with separate evidence. This full receipt read recovered53–end after truncation and inspects no current private pack/source/browser/save; human review remains optional.

reviews.disposition:
Full original lane plus later C1 integration chronology under AD32/AD36/AD42/AD43. Baseline already had civil/clerk entry and later church profiles, so no duplicate start was needed. The29−8−12−4=5-pound priced opening is proposed background funding/accounting, not charges deducted twice or native paper/clothing/travel items. Existing5-year term/secrecy/travel claims differ from an actual general enforcement engine. First-week-on-signing and seven-day collect_pay are existing authored command semantics, not new primary-source wage certification. Historical probationer carryover predates the later launch slice's own purse rule.

New enrollment adds only existing-map knowledge, staged with actual publication; old civil balances/contract timestamps and no-entry-history saves stay unchanged. The initial workroom-based knowledge basis failed real save validation before report-in created that situation; replacing it with supported optional unattributed knowledge plus validation is the recorded correction. No old save history, money or assets are backfilled. Earlier73-pass/one-import-failing-file wildcard is superseded at the later integration identity by91/91 after replacing tests for the retired assessor/factory API with current pathwayDoses cases. No removed runtime API was restored simply to satisfy copied context. Initial uncommitted/no-merge text is historical after40e186d1 andba40dcc9d.

Both fresh profiles earn/spend and roundtrip via native UI/test-hook clock.102+12−24+18=108;1200+720+12−24+18=1926, with repeated salary disabled. Original baseline old-save1920 proof, five earlier pathway fixtures and later integration browser build have distinct identities; do not add them into one uninterrupted route. The final Q3 gate retains no full npm test here—reserved for final Q5—and no proof of natural weekly pacing or14/21 matrix. Optional fonts404 means fallback typography, not font parity. Q3 source integration is distinct from master publication/normal-app adoption and all of Q4/Q5. All final hashes/table/C1 paragraphs were read. No actual source, profile/save, screenshot, artifact or current branch was inspected by this document review; human taste is optional AD42.
